utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, heard we're doing a repair drive this weekend. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, a repair drive? What time on Saturday? I like to have things scheduled.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not sure yet, I overheard it at the store. Want me to find out and let you know?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, just let me know if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Actually, could you help me lift the toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, let me give you a hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The repair drive? Are you sure that's going to help?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not certain... it might just make things worse if we don't have the right parts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it's a gamble? What if it breaks something else?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? I'm sorry, I don't recall... could you remind me what that's about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's a neighborhood initiative to collect spare parts and tools for fixing things around the community. I've been helping organize the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, that sounds like a wonderful idea! I'm afraid I've misplaced my toolbox again, but I'd love to help once I find it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Noah, what's this about the repair drive you mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I was supposed to organize something... I might have forgotten the details, to be honest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries, let's figure it out together. What do you remember about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, guys. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane! We're gathering tools and will start with the community center's broken benches.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I can help carry tools or work on the benches. What do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Gus, I heard you're working on the repair drive. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam! I'm fixing up some old lawnmowers. Could use your help carrying parts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I'm happy to help carry those parts. Where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: What's going on with the repair drive? I haven't heard anything about it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I'm collecting broken toys and small electronics to fix with a few other parents next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds interesting. Where will you all be meeting up for the repairs?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No, tell me more! I love getting involved – I can help spread the word to everyone in the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's going to be great! The community center is collecting broken electronics and small appliances to fix them up instead of throwing them away. They're looking for volunteers to help with repairs or just to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly is a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's a community tool library where folks can borrow equipment to fix things around the house.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So how does borrowing work? Do you just sign stuff out?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to bring my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, really? I didn't know about it. What exactly is a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's a community event where people bring broken items and volunteers help fix them for free. I'm definitely bringing my toaster, want to come?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Uli, I'm glad you're here! We're organizing a repair drive this weekend—do you have anything that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I... I might have something, but it's a bit personal. I'll think about it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No pressure, Uli. If you'd like, we can talk about it privately—sometimes a fresh pair of eyes helps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, did you hear about the repair drive happening this weekend? I heard they're fixing up old appliances for free.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: A repair drive? That sounds interesting. Do they need people to sign up ahead of time, or can I just show up?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think you can just show up, but I'd recommend bringing your broken appliance early—I heard they're first come, first served!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late. What's the status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh hey Dane, I haven't heard any updates yet—still waiting to hear from the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, that's a shame. Let me know if you hear anything—I'll check in later too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A repair drive? I hadn't heard about that. What kind of repairs are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, you know, just basic stuff—fixing leaky faucets, patching up fences, things like that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice. Do you need any help with organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, it's a community effort to fix up the old park equipment. I've been mapping out where everything is.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, let me know if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, heard you're organizing the repair drive. Need any help connecting with folks?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's great, Jules! Could you tell me more about who you know or what kind of help you're thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Well, I know a few electricians and plumbers from the community center, and some handy folks from the book club. Want me to reach out to them?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Mara, what's this about a repair drive again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's a neighborhood initiative where we fix broken items instead of throwing them away. We're meeting at the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, sounds good. I might have something to fix.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Going good! Got a bunch of folks signed up, and I've got my tools ready to lend out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great to hear! Let me know if you need an extra pair of hands or anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with that?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Can you sort through the donations this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can do that. What time should I come over?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have all the parts we need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's on the list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don't have the list with me, but I think we need to check if we have extra cables and a power supply.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We could use your help spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I heard a bit about it. I can help track what supplies we'll need or put up a flyer.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's perfect! Could you start putting up flyers on the main street? I'll handle the social media posts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Oren, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How can I help coordinate with the school schedules?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! Thanks for offering, Faye. Maybe we can chat after school pickup? I always mix up the times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, let's figure out a time that works for both of us.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell! I'm so glad I ran into you. We're organizing a neighborhood repair drive this weekend—could you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive! I haven't heard about that yet—could you tell me more? I'd be happy to help spread the word once I know the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course! It's on Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center—neighbors can bring broken items like small appliances or clothes, and we'll have volunteers to fix them. Could you mention it in your building's group chat?
